name: Marshall Islands
summary: A blue field with two diagonal stripes of orange and white widening toward the fly, and a white star with 24 rays in the upper hoist. Designed by Emlain Kabua, wife of the first president.
origin: The Marshall Islands became self-governing on 1 May 1979, leaving the US-administered Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands. Emlain Kabua, wife of President Amata Kabua, designed the flag.

colors.name: Orange
colors.meaning: The Ralik Chain (sunset), and bravery and wealth.

symbols.name: Diagonal stripes
symbols.description: Orange and white stripes rising from the lower hoist.
symbols.meaning: The two island chains, and the equator, with the islands just north of it.

symbols.name: Star with 24 rays
symbols.description: A white star with 24 points; four longer points form a cross.
symbols.meaning: The 24 municipalities; the cross symbolises Christianity.

facts: The rising stripes suggest the islands' growth and development.
Bikini Atoll, site of US nuclear tests, is in the Marshall Islands.
The country became fully independent under a Compact of Free Association with the US in 1986.
clues: Blue with orange and white diagonal stripes and a white star with 24 points.
Its stripes are two island chains named after sunrise and sunset.
Its star's points stand for 24 municipalities.
